text:
Guadalajara, capital ne kurow a ɛwɔ Mexican state Jalisco mu a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ paa, wɔde too hɔ wɔ 14 February 1542 wɔ Atemajac Valley — deɛ ɛdi akyiri wɔ relocations a ɛfiri 1532. Wɔ 1560 mu no ɛbɛyɛɛ Nueva Galicia capital, na ɛhyɛ ne ho nkuran a ɛkɔ so daa. Ne metropolitan area, a ɛwɔ nnipa bɛyɛ 5.3 million wɔ 2020, yɛ deɛ ɛto so mmiɛnsa wɔ Mexico mu.

Wɔfrɛ kurow no "most Mexican of Mexican cities" daa, na ɛyɛ nokware: Guadalajara yɛ mariachi, tequila, charrería ne Ballet Folklórico ti, amammerɛ a ɛyɛ Mexico ho mfonini no mu.

Football kɔ akyiri saa ara. Kurow no din ne C.D. Guadalajara — a wɔfrɛ no Chivas — a wɔde too hɔ wɔ 1906 na ɛyɛ Mexico club a ɛyɛ popular ne nkonim paa mmienu, a ɛyɛ famous sɛ ɛde Mexican players nko ara bɔ. Chivas yɛ Estadio Akron tenant, stadium a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ 2010 wɔ Zapopan suburb, a ɛyɛ Guadalajara metropolitan area mu na ɛyɛ 2026 World Cup beaeɛ. Metro no nso wɔ Liga MX side Atlas, na ɛma kurow no club a ɛto so mmienu wɔ top-flight. Ansa na Chivas bɛyɛ wɔn ankasa beaeɛ no, Guadalajara bɔ agorɔ wɔ historic Estadio Jalisco, beaeɛ a ɛyɛ 1970 ne 1986 World Cups — lineage a ɛde kurow no kɔ Mexican football fie mu.
